newsitem.title: USA: Apple cuts prices on computer servers.
newsitem.headline: Apple cuts prices on computer servers.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said on Monday it had cut U.S. prices by 12 to 23 percent on its Macintosh-based computer Workgroup Servers.

"The aggressive price reductions of the Workgroup Servers significantly increase the price/performance and value of Apple's Mac OS client/server solutions," said John Osborne, senior director of Server Marketing.
Apple said its Workgroup Server 6150/66, which used to range in price from $2,300 to $2,400, depending on the retailer, should now range from $1,900 to $2,000.
At the top end of the product line, the Workgroup Server 8550/200 should now be priced at $6,000 to $6,100, down from $6,900 to $7,000 previously, Apple said.
